blocks.content: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

rows: Central banking, monetary policy & financial regulation

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
The setup was based on the recommendations of the Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance, also known as the Hilton Young Commission.
Initially established as a private shareholders' bank with a fully paid-up capital of ₹5 crore.
Nationalized on January 1, 1949, under the Reserve Bank (Transfer to Public Ownership) Act, 1948.
The Central Office was permanently relocated from Kolkata to Mumbai in 1937.
Hilton Young Commission (1926) is frequently asked as the recommending body for setting up RBI.
Distinguish between Statutory Bodies (created by Parliament Act) and Constitutional Bodies (mentioned in the Constitution).
RBI was nationalized on January 1, 1949, transforming it from a private shareholders' bank into a fully state-owned entity.
